title: H2-B: preserve the OR binding when a finite relation marker is grouped with either side
phase: Manual exploratory construction using already exposed source contexts. No blind prediction, new corpus experiment, parser, independent semantic evidence or reserved test.

decision_note.unknown: Does the existing H2 role direction have a coherent finite realization across suffix dalor, free or and prefix-looking oraiin/orain, without turning the marker onto a different dependent merely because a reader placed a space differently?
decision_note.predecessors: General composition, old quantity interpretations and prefix-function alternatives already exist.759/760 boundary facts remain at their original normalized scope;548/555 are raw content functions,1140 executed a different possessive constructor. No old meaning is inherited.
decision_note.decision_changes: Preserving the same typed edge gives an explicit finite H2-B construction. Reversing it is a rival binding, not a harmless spelling change. Neither selects historical direction; do not use U/R shared endpoints or extra nominal fits as semantic confirmation.
decision_note.smallest_test: Compare explicit equations and source positions at the two known759 bridges, existing dalor cheol and exact cheol oraiin. Retain reader-sensitive dalor aiin and unresolved dalor dy continuation as limits. Independent primary/source/semantic reviews only.
decision_note.budget: 40 minutes total including preparation, manual authorship, validation and publication, starting approximately13:55UTC. No decoder/control implementation or automatic expansion.

H2_B.entry_status: dalor=DAL+OR is the existing N1/H hypothesis; the two OR+A expansions are newly proposed finite realizations motivated by old reader boundary variants. AIN and AIIN remain distinct whole descriptions. No other string is split, and daiin is not decomposed into d+aiin here.
H2_B.shared_operator: In a licensed nominal sequence N OR A, the existing H2 contribution remains Role_or(a)=n: A is the governor, N its dependent. A physical raw-group boundary is not itself the rule for which endpoint is the dependent.
H2_B.hypothetical_alignment: These three surface diagrams express one construction schema; not all three variants are observed at one physical site or with the same N/A words.
H2_B.types: DAL and CHEOL retain the old unassigned nominal descriptions D and C. AIIN/AIN nominal head types are explicit new assumptions, supported by no selected content value. Nominal types of chckhy or lkain are not silently supplied.
H2_B.role_contract: Role_or is the same single-valued slot of the original U/H model. A written head referent and a dependent referent need not be identical or different. Output is a nominal expression, not a complete proposition.
H2_B.boundaries: Finite analytical expansion preserves each original group ID, raw spelling and seam. No normalization of the source, uncertain separator crossing, drawing bridge, or paragraph crossing. Clear within-paragraph wraps require the explicit H2 rule and own-reader flags.
H2_B.joint_reading_cost: Requiring the accepted fused and split transcriptions to preserve one binding is an explicit model contract. The manuscript does not establish that every alternate segmentation is simultaneously correct; a boundary-sensitive rival may instead commit to one reading.

direction_rival.reversed_prefix_candidate: If OR in orA marks A as dependent and preceding N is then chosen as governor, Role_or(n)=a.
direction_rival.necessary_extra_assumption: Prefix marking alone does not identify the governor; choosing preceding N is part of the reversed rival.
direction_rival.conditional_mismatch: The reversed binding does not preserve the same directed edge under the H2-B contract. It is not thereby a false historical reading.
direction_rival.equivalence_limits: When a=n, or when the particular role graph has both directions, the truth conditions can coincide. Symmetry/involutivity of a functional role is sufficient in the relevant domain. No direction or meaning is selected from these equations alone.

decision: Retain the finite direction-preserving H2-B construction and its raw-reader qualifications. The OR relation now has one explicit role across a left-bound and a right-bound form in actual source contexts. That is an authored writing-rule hypothesis, not a selected word meaning or corpus-wide mechanism. U versus R remains unselected.
